[[-21.6,64.2],[-21.6,-64.2],[21.6,-64.2],[21.6,64.2]]

  3. elevated view over the rooftops of the pedimented front and the green-copper pitched roof (low resolution, processed look)

Reply with the JSON object only.

json.notes: 1) The cella is 36 m wide and sits almost against the flank colonnades, so the columns read as a fence bolted to a wall; in the photographs the peristyle stands clear with a deep gap to the cella, so the cella must be narrower. 2) The front portico is too shallow and its eight columns are hidden by the roof, so the sculpted pediment does not read as the building's face; the portico must stand clear of the cella and the pediment must sit on it. 3) The flank columns are slightly too slender and the cella walls render grey and dull; the columns need a bit more girth and the stone colour should stay the cream of the photographs. The model keeps a stone podium, a green gable roof reaching 36 m, and the two long flank colonnades of 22 columns each.
